import json, random
random.seed(7)
def build(name, per_pkt_frames, datalen, npkts=20000, ntr=32, scatter=False):
    traces=[]
    ev=0; pk=0; fr=0; data=0
    sent={'I':[[0,4611686018427387903]],'H':[[0,4611686018427387903]],'A':[[0,4611686018427387903]]}
    per_trace_ev = 20000//ntr
    per_trace_pk = npkts//ntr
    for ti in range(ntr):
        events=[{'t':0,'op':'key','level':'A','action':'install'}]
        ev+=1
        pkts_per_dg = 16
        ndg = per_trace_pk//pkts_per_dg
        for e in range(ndg):
            pkts=[]
            for i in range(pkts_per_dg):
                frames=[]
                for k in range(per_pkt_frames):
                    if data+datalen > 2*1024*1024: break
                    off = random.randint(0,10**15) if scatter else (fr*17)%100000
                    frames.append({'type':'STREAM','id':(i*7)%2000,'offset':off,'data_hex':'ab'*datalen,'fin':False})
                    fr+=1; data+=datalen
                pkts.append({'level':'A','pn':e*16+i,'auth':True,'frames':frames})
                pk+=1
            events.append({'t':(e+1)*10,'op':'datagram','bytes':1200,'packets':pkts})
            ev+=1
        traces.append({'id':'t%d'%ti,'config':{'early':False,'overlap':'first','buffer_packets':64,'idle_ms':0,
           'max_streams_bidi':1024,'max_streams_uni':1024,'max_stream_data':65536,'max_data':4611686018427387903,
           'crypto_limit':65536,'sent':sent},'events':events})
    req=json.dumps({'version':1,'traces':traces}).encode()
    print(name,'ev',ev,'pk',pk,'fr',fr,'data',data, 'reqMB', round(len(req)/1e6,2))
    open('/app/work/%s.json'%name,'wb').write(req)
build('s_frames', 3, 34)          # ~60000 frames, 2MiB data, contiguous-ish offsets
build('s_scatter', 3, 34, scatter=True)  # scattered offsets
build('s_bigframes', 1, 2048)     # big frames

cd /app/submission && for f in s_frames s_scatter s_bigframes; do echo "== $f"; /usr/bin/time -f "%e s  %M KB" python3 -I /app/submission/entry.py < /app/work/$f.json > /app/work/$f.out 2>/app/work/$f.err; echo rc=$?; cat /app/work/$f.err | tail -3; ls -l /app/work/$f.out; done
